name: Egyptian Pyramids Explorer
summary:
Egyptian Pyramids Explorer is a VR exploration experience that lets you step into detailed 3D historical environments and observe ancient landmarks from a new perspective.

Walk through an immersive Egyptian pyramid environment, explore the atmosphere of ancient architecture, and experience the scale of these iconic structures in virtual reality. The experience also includes the ancient city of Assos, offering another historical 3D environment to discover and observe.

This is not a fast-paced action game.
